name: Help Scout
description: Help Scout is a customer support platform providing shared inboxes, knowledge base management (Docs), and customer messaging tools.

evidence.claim: Help Scout Mailbox API uses OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows.
Help Scout Docs API uses an API Key found in the user profile security settings.
Help Scout provides a REST API covering Mailbox, Docs, and Chat functionality.
There are community-developed MCP servers for Help Scout on GitHub.
Help Scout offers a self-serve signup with a free trial.

notes: Help Scout uses OAuth 2.0 for its Mailbox and Chat APIs, while the Docs API (knowledge base) uses a separate API Key system. Multiple community-built MCP servers exist for integrating with LLMs.
search_queries_used: Help Scout authentication OAuth API key developer docs
